newsitem.title: JAMAICA: CRICKET-FIRST TEST HEADS FOR DRAW AFTER RAIN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-FIRST TEST HEADS FOR DRAW AFTER RAIN.

text.p: The first test between West Indies and India was heading for a draw after a rain-delayed start on the fifth and final day on Monday.
There was no play before tea and when the game did get under way, West Indies declared 322 ahead and left India to survive a minimum of 38 overs.
India reached 29 for one with 23 overs left, losing opener Navjot Sidhu when he was caught by Roland Holder at short leg off Courtney Walsh for nought.
Walsh had declared West Indies second innings at the overnight 241 for four.
